impl.summary: Skills W7 built on o/w2s-w7 (worktree /home/user/wt/o-w2s-w7, 8 commits, not pushed). A skill can now span studios: recipe version 2 puts {{steps.<key>.output}} in a step's input, tool steps can go anywhere in the order, and each run is kept in a new skill_runs table that a 10 s sweep moves forward. For example a dub, then captions, then a 9:16 cut each start by themselves when the step before finishes. If a step fails, the steps after it fail too and the run says which step failed and why. Studio dry runs now exist: runAsDemo/inDemoScope on AsyncLocalStorage, chooseRoute returns the demo route inside that scope and createGenerations marks the rows request.demo. After a check, what it made goes to the Trash and the studio records it opened are deleted. Save as skill now writes cross-call studio references as step references instead of refusing them. The run's result names the run and the steps that wait, everywhere a skill runs: the Run toast ('See progress'), run_skill, schedules (they go through run_skill) and the CLI (--wait follows the run). The skill dialog has a Runs section showing 'Dub · done → Captions · running → 9:16 cut · waiting' with 'Open in <Studio>'. Already there from earlier packages: W1's runner, checks and Run dialog; W3's run_skill and draftFromThread; W4's schedules and CLI; the request.demo flag with forceDemo in chooseRoute and chainMode; stampRequests; createPipeline's existing option.

The sweep runs every 10 s (the brief's model ran every 30 s), so a later step can start up to 10 s after the step before it finishes. findings.title: CLI --wait/--out never finishes for a CSV of more than 8 staged rows: the runs route only returns a skill's 8 newest runs
findings.where: bin/lib/commands.mjs waitRuns (mine.length === runIds.length); src/app/api/assist/skills/[name]/runs/route.ts calls listSkillRuns(name) with its default limit 8 (src/server/skill-runs.ts listSkillRuns)
findings.detail: RECIPE_LIMITS.rows is 50 and runRecipe starts one skill_runs row per CSV row. `fuobe skills run <staged skill> --rows file.csv --wait` with 9+ rows polls GET /api/assist/skills/<name>/runs, which never lists more than 8 runs, so `mine.length === runIds.length` is never true. The CLI waits until --timeout (30 min by default) and exits with EXIT.timeout even though every run has ended, and it never saves the earlier rows' outputs with --out. The same happens with 8 rows or fewer when another run of the same skill (a schedule, the Run dialog) starts while it waits and pushes one out of the newest 8. Verified by tracing; no test covers more than one run (tests/cli-run.test.ts has one staged run).
findings.fix: Let the route take ?ids= (or a limit up to RECIPE_LIMITS.rows) and have waitRuns ask for its own run ids, or add GET /api/assist/skills/[name]/runs/[id]; add a CLI test with more than 8 rows.

findings.title: faceless_episode is declared to make a video, but its tool result names only the stills, so a step that takes its output always fails and the episode step reads 'done' too early
findings.where: src/lib/recipe.ts TOOL_MAKES.faceless_episode = 'video'; src/server/assist/studio-routes.ts facelessRoute.run returns ids: stills.slice(0, 8); src/server/skill-runs.ts startPart/settle/outputOf
findings.detail: recipeProblems accepts {faceless_episode} -> {add_captions video: {{steps.ep.output}}} (checked: recipeProblems returns []). At run time the part's ids are the episode's stills (images), so settle() marks the Faceless step done once those pictures finish, while the episode is still animating and mixing in stage two. outputOf(key, 'video') then finds no video and fillRefs throws '“ep” made no video for the next step', so every later step fails after stage one has been paid for. The Runs section also shows 'Faceless Studio · done' while the episode is still rendering. A dry run would catch it (the later step fails, so the check fails), but the format promises a combination it can't run, and a single-step faceless recipe's new studio dry run passes after the stills only and then deletes the episode mid-render. Related: Faceless's stage two is created by its own 2 s sweep outside the runAsDemo scope, so in a dry run with Demo mode off it could start for real if that sweep beats the discard.
findings.fix: Either drop faceless_episode from TOOL_MAKES (refuse a reference to it in refProblems) or track the episode, so the part settles on the episode's final generation, and carry the demo mark into stage two.

findings.title: The demo scope isn't left by outsideRuns, so a long-lived timer first started inside a dry run would route every later run on the install to the demo provider
findings.detail: ensureRunner wraps startRunner in outsideRuns precisely so an AsyncLocalStorage scope isn't captured by the runner's setInterval, but outsideRuns doesn't leave the new demo scope. getGeneration/createGenerations call ensureRunner. If the runner (or its fastTimer after a dev hot reload) is first created inside runAsDemo, every later tick, including advanceDependents re-planning other runs' waiting steps through chooseRoute, would see inDemoScope() true and run as demos. In production src/instrumentation.ts starts the runner at boot, so this is latent (tests and the hot-reload path are where it could bite).
findings.fix: Have outsideRuns (or ensureRunner) also run outside the demo scope (for example scope.exit), and do the same for ensureSkillRunSweep.

findings.title: A 'free' studio dry run with Demo mode off can still call the install's LLM and leave records behind
findings.where: src/server/assist/studio-routes.ts adsRoute.run -> createManualBrand -> llmText (src/server/brand.ts), ads copy (src/server/ads.ts); faceless askLlm and restore.ts check getSetting('demoMode') directly
findings.detail: runAsDemo only changes chooseRoute and createGenerations. The implementer noted the kit; the LLM spend isn't noted, and the docs call the check free.

fix.finalSummary: Skills W7 (skills that span studios) is done, with the review's fixes. Recipe v2's {{steps.<key>.output}}, staged runs in skill_runs moved on by a 10 s sweep, the failure cascade, surviving a restart, studio dry runs inside runAsDemo, Save as skill linking, the Runs section, run_skill/toast/schedule/CLI results that name the waiting steps, and CLI --wait (now for any number of rows). Fixed here: the CLI no longer waits forever on 9+ rows; a Faceless episode's output can't be referenced (its result is only the stills), and Faceless is checked by its plan only; the demo scope can't leak into long-lived timers; a dry run asks no AI helper. Engines: everything was verified in demo mode on the mock provider only (unit/integration tests, plus the implementer's browser check at 1440/390 px, light and dark). Cloud: the staged chain uses the same studio tools and hosted models as before, but nothing has run with a paid key. Open engine: same, nothing has run on a GPU. A dub feeding a later step must use review:false, which the open engine's studio refuses, so the tool's own Library pipeline runs there. Public sign-up: the runs route (GET, including ?ids=) and running skills belong to the owner. Guests are refused (401) and accounts are refused (403) by the proxy, as tests/public-signup.test.ts shows. The sweep only moves owner runs, and no new file-reading path exists for account runs.
fix.left: Docs pass (STATUS.md / DEVELOPMENT.md): add the Skills W7 line, the e2e entry `node tests/e2e/skills-span.mjs [url]` and the runs route (with ?ids=) in the Assist route table. The ARCHITECTURE.md line about run_skill not existing yet predates this package. A single Faceless step in a staged run still shows 'done' in the Runs section once its stills finish, while the episode keeps rendering in Faceless Studio (it has an 'Open in Faceless Studio' link); tracking the episode's final generation is a possible follow-up. A create_ads dry run keeps the brand kit it made. createPipeline's `existing` option is still unused. Nothing has run with paid keys or on a GPU. Migration 27 (skill_runs) stays the last entry; the integrator may renumber it.
